observations: A large, complex mechanical assembly, likely an engine or transmission, mounted on a stand.
The unit is heavily used, with visible rust, dirt, and wear on the casing.
Multiple hoses, wires, and mechanical components are attached to the main block.
The background shows a cluttered workshop or scrap yard environment.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are legible in the photo.

claims.claim: never buy an item because it's cheap

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

risks.risk: The unit may be a low-value generic part rather than a specific brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the engine or transmission running.
Clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used engine or transmission from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-functional generic part.
